title: Tub arrived broken with cutters falling out of it
text:
Tub arrived broken with cutters falling out of it. Presumably, this was packed already broken as the box it arrived in was undamaged. The plastic tub arrived cracked and the cutters were already half out, so not the best first impression.

The cutters seem to be okay, so that's the most important part, but I do wish that more care was put into the picking, packing, shipping, and handling when a new product is purchased.

Should be an easy 4 stars, but I'm giving 2 because of the damage.
